payload.title: Quarterly measurement
payload.thesis: A predeclared family of measurements may differ from zero.

evaluationContract.observationUnit: One non-overlapping calendar quarter per symbol.
evaluationContract.familyDefinition: EURUSD and XAUUSD, one two-sided test per symbol; no other tests.
evaluationContract.decisionRule: Holm correction across the two tests at family-wise alpha 0.05; otherwise inconclusive.
